questions.text: What time does Aizhan's alarm ring every morning?
questions.hint: "My alarm rings at 6:30 every morning."

questions.text: Aizhan sometimes presses snooze when her alarm rings.
questions.hint: "I get up immediately — I never press snooze!"

questions.text: How long does it take Aizhan to walk to her academic building?
questions.hint: "I walk from the dormitory to the main academic building — it takes about ten minutes."

questions.text: What does Aizhan usually eat for breakfast?
questions.hint: "I usually eat porridge or an omelette with bread and a glass of orange juice."

questions.text: Aizhan always sits in the ___ row because it helps her concentrate.
questions.hint: "I always sit in the second row — it helps me concentrate."

questions.text: What do Aizhan and Dias do after lunch?
opts: They go to Computer Science class.
They sit in the library for twenty minutes.
questions.correct: They sit in the library for twenty minutes.
questions.hint: "Dias and I often sit in the library for twenty minutes."

questions.text: Aizhan's classes finish at 4:00 pm every day.
questions.hint: "Classes finish at 3:30 pm every day."

questions.text: What does Aizhan do for five minutes before going to sleep?
questions.hint: "Before I sleep, I write in my diary for five minutes."

questions.text: What time does Zarina get up every morning?
questions.hint: "I get up at 7:15. I press snooze at least twice." — Zarina.

questions.text: Zarina always eats a full breakfast before class.
questions.hint: "Sometimes I skip breakfast. I just grab a banana and run to class." — Zarina.

questions.text: How long does Zarina do yoga every morning?
questions.hint: "I do yoga every morning — ten minutes. It gives me energy!" — Zarina.

questions.text: Aizhan listens to English ___ on her walk to class.
questions.hint: "I listen to English podcasts on my walk to class. It helps me wake up!" — Aizhan.

questions.text: When does Zarina feel most energetic?
questions.hint: "Definitely afternoon. After lunch I feel amazing." — Zarina.

questions.text: Aizhan stretches for five minutes every morning after waking up.
questions.hint: "First, I stretch for five minutes and wash my face." — Aizhan.

questions.text: Zarina ___ yoga every morning before class.
questions.hint: Zarina = She → She does. He/She/It + does for "do".

questions.text: "She don't get up early" is correct English.
questions.hint: She → doesn't. "She doesn't get up early." Never "don't" with He/She/It.

questions.text: ___ Aizhan call her parents every evening? (question)
questions.hint: Aizhan = She → Does she call...? (base form after Does).

questions.text: Which sentence is correct?
opts: He go to the library after lunch.
questions.hint: Dias = He → studies. Others have errors: study→studies, go→goes, eats→eat.

questions.text: Where does the adverb go? Choose the correct sentence.
opts: She calls her parents always evening.
questions.hint: Adverbs of frequency go BEFORE the main verb: "She always calls..."

questions.text: I ___ (never / press) snooze — I get up immediately!
questions.hint: "never" goes before the main verb. "I never press snooze."

questions.text: "Does she studies every evening?" is correct English.
questions.hint: After Does → base form. "Does she study every evening?" NOT "studies".

questions.text: Which negative sentence is correct?
questions.hint: doesn't + base form. Never "doesn't skips" — no -s after doesn't.

questions.text: What does "routine" mean?
opts: a set of actions you do regularly in the same order
questions.correct: a set of actions you do regularly in the same order
questions.hint: Routine = a fixed set of regular actions. "I love my morning routine at WKU."

questions.text: Before sleeping, Aizhan writes in her ___ for five minutes.
questions.hint: Diary = дневник — a book where you write your thoughts each day.

questions.text: What does "exhausted" mean?
questions.hint: Exhausted = измотанный — far more tired than just "tired". "Mornings are exhausting for me!" — Zarina.

questions.text: "To snooze" means to wake up and get out of bed immediately.
questions.hint: Snooze = to press the alarm button to get a few more minutes of sleep. The opposite of getting up immediately.

questions.text: What does "productive" describe?
opts: achieving a lot and using time well
questions.correct: achieving a lot and using time well
questions.hint: Productive = продуктивный. "I have a very productive morning when I wake up early."

questions.text: Zarina sometimes ___ breakfast and just grabs a banana.
questions.hint: Skip = пропускать. "Sometimes I skip breakfast." — Zarina.

questions.text: What is "compote"?
questions.hint: Compote = компот — a sweet drink made by boiling fruit in water. Common in Kazakh cafeterias.

questions.text: What does "concentrate" mean?
opts: to give all your attention to something
questions.correct: to give all your attention to something
questions.hint: "I always sit in the second row — it helps me concentrate." — Aizhan.
